shorts_rules: State the core topic or paradox within the very first sentence without generic introductory fluff.
Hook the viewer immediately in the first 3 seconds using a stark visual shock, a counterintuitive contradiction, or an urgent question.
Ground massive or microscopic numbers immediately by comparing them side-by-side with familiar physical objects like cars or football fields.
Never hide the core product, subject, or app name until the very end; introduce it early to maintain high retention.
Strictly adhere to our fixed time limits: exactly 20 to 25 seconds for news items, and 30 to 35 seconds for big questions.
Structure the middle beats around a fast escalation, step-by-step mechanical breakdown, or multi-tier progression.
Replace abstract philosophical closing questions with concrete statements, visual climaxes, or our mandatory outro line.
Always conclude every single video with our fixed sign-off line: 'Follow Tomorrowly for tomorrow's tech, today.'
visual_sound_notes: Use medium-sized sans-serif captions with a high-contrast black outline, animating 1 to 3 words at a time with key terms highlighted in yellow or red.
Maintain a fast-paced cutting frequency between 2.5 and 5.0 cuts per 10 seconds, perfectly synchronized with visual beats and sound effects.
Pair high-fidelity 3D CGI cutaways or real-world cinematic tracking shots with ambient mechanical whooshes, muffled impacts, and rising drone synth music.
Ensure background music remains tightly balanced at a moderate loudness well beneath a clear, punchy voice-over.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine wohi shorts zyada viral hui hain jinhon ne shuru ke 3 seconds mein koi hairan kun baat ya visual shock diya hai. Hamari purani videos mein log shuruat mein ya ajeeb aakhri sawal par drop ho rahe hain, is liye humein bekaar intro khatam karke direct topic par aana hoga. Har video ka time fix rakhna zaroori hai (news ke liye 20-25 seconds aur big questions ke liye 30-35 seconds). Aakhri line hamesha 'Follow Tomorrowly for tomorrow's tech, today.' hi honi chahiye aur complex numbers ko aam cheezon ke sath compare karke feelable banana hoga.
